看着眼前这个美女一副快要死翘翘的模样，杨云帆不但没有任何怜香惜玉，反而眼神里有些鄙视。
不就是痛经吗？至于弄出这样一副要死不活的样子吗？搞得跟被人捅了一刀似的。小爷我从小到大又不是没有见过女人，有哪个女人痛经会痛成这样的？
这个女人，有点矫情。
“小哥，帮我叫一下我的朋友。我肚子好痛，我快要不行了……”那大美女眼泪汪汪，虚汗直流，捂着肚子，浑身都在打颤。她抬起她那张梨花带雨的俏脸，哀求一般的看着杨云帆。
谁知道杨云帆根本不屑一顾，撇撇嘴道：“不就是痛经吗？这点小事情，还叫什么人？你把手给我。”
说完，杨云帆直接抓过那大美女的一只柔荑，然后，将她的手放在自己的手心上，比划了一下，找准了她虎口的一个位置。
“你，你要做什么？”
大美女意识到不对劲了。
自己旁边这个“农民工”非但不帮自己叫人，还趁机占自己便宜，摸自己的小手！
这还得了！
她顿时吓得惊慌失色。
可是眼下，她连说话都没力气了，别说是把手从杨云帆的魔爪里面抽出来了。
“小哥，求求你，不要这样……”
一瞬间，她眼泪汪汪，瘪着嘴巴，万分哀求的看着杨云帆，希望他能放自己一马。
“你搞笑呢？大庭广众之下，我能干什么？不就是帮帮你嘛。嘿嘿，刚才，不是你让我帮帮你的吗？”
杨云帆嘿嘿一笑。
然而，旁边那大美女一看眼前这个“农民工”如此奸诈的一笑，顿时觉得五雷轰顶。
这一刻，她看过的无数电影，无数电视剧里面的流氓反叛之魂，齐齐附体在杨云帆身上。杨云帆就像是一个十足的大恶棍，色中饿鬼，竟然饥不择食，食不择地到如此地步！
“求求你，不要这样……”

她身子往后不停的瑟缩。
然而，她坐在靠窗的位置，被杨云帆挡住了全部身影，看不到外面的情况。外面的人，估计也看不到她在里面的样子。这真是叫天天不灵，叫地地不灵啊！
一瞬间，她的脑海里闪过无数个画面，脸色也变得更加的惨白，额头上的虚汗更是疯了一样的往外狂涌。像极了QQ表情里面的瀑布汗。
“不就是痛经吗？流那么多汗。”
杨云帆抬头看了一眼那美女，顿时无语了。他可不知道眼前这个大美女脑子里在想什么。
“啊！痛！你这个臭流氓，干什么捏我啊？”
就在这时，杨云帆手上一用力，那美女顿时轻呼一声，索性豁出去了，就要大叫起来。
“你瞎叫什么呢？吓我一跳！我在给你治疗痛经呢！”哪知道，杨云帆声音比她还大，吼了她一句。
那美女顿时跟受了惊的兔子一样，缩在那里不敢动了，恐惧的看着杨云帆。
“我，我没瞎叫……你捏的人家痛。”那美女瘪着嘴巴，委屈极了。可是又不敢大声叫，怕得罪眼前这个“农民工”。
俗话说，狠的怕愣的，富的怕穷的。眼前这个“农民工”，在她看来，那是又愣又穷，指不定干出什么丧天害理的事来。自己这个小羔羊只能懦弱的委曲求全了。
求求菩萨保佑，乘务员赶紧临检吧。到时候，自己就举报他对自己耍流氓！
“痛？那就说明有效果了！”
杨云帆看也不看那美女，抓着她的手，在虎口上使劲捏起来：“看到没，这个穴位叫合谷穴，也就是虎口。痛经的时候，你自己也可以捏。大致位置，就在手背的第一、二掌骨之间。”
一边说，杨云帆一边在这个位置上重重揉捏了几下。
“咦，被这个臭流氓捏了几下，我肚子好像真的不痛了。”直到这会儿，那个美女才发现，自己好像是误会眼前这个臭流氓了。他好像真的是在给自己治痛经。
幸亏刚才没有大喊大叫，不然丢人丢大发了。
想到这里，又感受到自己的小手正被一个陌生男人抓在那里揉搓，她的脸蛋有些微微的泛红。眼眸之中，跳动着一丝尴尬。
大概捏了十分钟，杨云帆看眼前这个美女脸色红润了不少，也不说痛了。反倒是一直低着头，好像很是舒坦。
“哼！”

他哼了一下，不由停下了动作。
其实痛经捏个五分钟也就差不多了，不过难得有大美女让自己占便宜，杨云帆当然要光明正大的占足便宜。
可现在，他发现，自己好像干了一件蠢事。

Seeing the beautiful woman in front of him looking like she was about to die, Yang Yunfan not only showed no sympathy for her, but also had a look of contempt in his eyes.
Isn’t it just dysmenorrhea? As for making such a desperate look? It felt like someone had stabbed me. Young Master, it’s not like I haven’t seen women since I was a child. Which woman would have such painful menstrual cramps?
This woman is a bit pretentious.
"Brother, call my friend for me. My stomach hurts so much, I'm about to die..." The beautiful woman burst into tears, sweating profusely, covering her stomach, and her whole body was trembling. She raised her pretty face and looked at Yang Yunfan pleadingly.
Who knew that Yang Yunfan didn't care at all, curled his lips and said: "Isn't it just dysmenorrhea? Why should I call someone such a small thing? Give me your hand."
After speaking, Yang Yunfan directly grabbed one of the beautiful women's catkins, then placed her hand on his palm, gestured, and found the right position for her tiger's mouth.
"You, what are you going to do?"
The beautiful woman realized something was wrong.
The "migrant worker" next to me not only didn't help him call someone, but also took advantage of him and touched his little hand!
That’s okay!
She was suddenly frightened and panicked.
But now, she didn't even have the strength to speak, let alone pull her hand out of Yang Yunfan's clutches.
"Brother, please, don't do this..."
For a moment, she burst into tears, pursed her lips, and looked at Yang Yunfan pleadingly, hoping that he would let her go.
"Are you being funny? What can I do in public? I just help you. Hehe, didn't you ask me to help you just now?"
Yang Yunfan chuckled.
However, when the beautiful woman next to her saw such a cunning smile from the "migrant worker" in front of her, she suddenly felt like she was struck by thunder.
At this moment, the gangster and rebellious souls from countless movies and TV series she had watched all possessed Yang Yunfan. Yang Yunfan is like a complete villain, a hungry ghost in lust, but he is so hungry that he can't choose what to eat, and he can't choose where to eat!
"Please, don't do this..."
She kept shrinking back.
However, she was sitting by the window and was completely blocked by Yang Yunfan, so she could not see what was going on outside. People outside probably couldn't see her inside. This is really making the sky and the earth not work!
In an instant, countless images flashed through her mind, her face became even paler, and the sweat on her forehead poured out like crazy. It looks like the waterfall of sweat in QQ emoticons.
"Isn't it just menstrual cramps? I'm sweating so much."
Yang Yunfan raised his head and glanced at the beautiful woman, and was immediately speechless. He didn't know what was going on in the mind of the beautiful woman in front of him.
"Ah! It hurts! You stinky scoundrel, why are you pinching me?"
At this moment, Yang Yunfan exerted force on his hand, and the beauty immediately let out a soft cry, and was about to scream as she risked her life.
"What are you yelling about? You scared me! I'm treating your dysmenorrhea!" Unexpectedly, Yang Yunfan's voice was louder than hers and he yelled at her.
The beautiful woman immediately acted like a frightened rabbit, hunkering down and not daring to move, looking at Yang Yunfan in fear.
"I, I didn't scream...it hurt when you pinched me." The beauty pursed her lips, feeling extremely aggrieved. But I didn't dare to shout loudly for fear of offending the "migrant worker" in front of me.
As the saying goes, the ruthless are afraid of being stupid, and the rich are afraid of poor. In her opinion, the "migrant worker" in front of her was stupid and poor, and might do something outrageous. As a little lamb, I can only cowardly compromise.
Please pray for the blessings of Bodhisattva, and the flight attendants should check it quickly. When the time comes, I will report him for playing rogue against me!
"It hurts? That means it's working!"Without looking at the beautiful woman, Yang Yunfan grabbed her hand and squeezed it hard on the tiger's mouth: "Did you see, this acupoint is called Hegu point, which is the tiger's mouth. You can also pinch it yourself when you have dysmenorrhea. The approximate location is between the first and second metacarpal bones on the back of your hand."
While talking, Yang Yunfan kneaded this position several times.
"Hey, after being pinched a few times by this stinky gangster, my stomach really doesn't hurt anymore." It was only then that the beauty realized that she seemed to have misunderstood the stinky gangster in front of her. He seemed to be really treating himself for menstrual cramps.
Fortunately, I didn't yell just now, otherwise it would be embarrassing.
Thinking of this, she felt her little hands being grabbed and rubbed by a strange man, and her face turned slightly red. There was a trace of embarrassment dancing in his eyes.
After about ten minutes of squeezing, Yang Yunfan saw that the face of the beautiful woman in front of him was much rosier, and she didn't feel any pain anymore. Instead, he kept his head down, as if he was very comfortable.
"Hmph!"
He snorted and couldn't help but stop.
In fact, five minutes of pinching for menstrual cramps is enough, but it is rare for a beautiful woman to let him take advantage. Of course, Yang Yunfan must take advantage openly and openly.
But now, he realized that he seemed to have done something stupid.
